artworks.title: Ajax Defending the Ships
artworks.description: Tiepolo's Ajax on the prow — the duel with Hector over a single ship when the wall broke and Troy reached the fleet.

artworks.title: The Burning of the Greek Fleet
artworks.description: Fire on the shore — Hector's torch on Protesilaus' ship and Patroclus weeping at Achilles' door.
